text:
Construction work can start on some portions of the system without waiting for all final design and right-of-way acquisition, and utility relocation work to be completed. Subsystem installation will closely follow.
During the latter part of the Construction stage, the recruitment and training of the operations and maintenance and security forces would be commenced. Prior to revenue service start-up, there would be a thorough operational test of the complete system to assure proper performance and safety, and response to emergency conditions.
Should one of the All-Bus Alternatives be selected, the Preliminary Engineering, Final Design and Construction stages will be so minor as to be almost negligible. In the construction stage, the lower capital cost, All-Bus Alternatives would primarily involve vehicle acquisition.
